description: Phase 3.2 D-07 / Phase 3.2.1: the languages each embedding catalog model declares, the one source of these declarations. src/lib/rag/embeddings/catalog.ts reads it at module load (every catalog model needs an entry, and every entry a catalog model); scripts/init-env.js and scripts/config-server.js read it through scripts/rag/language-settings-context.js. Codes are language-pack codes of config/rag/language-packs.json. default_profile is the profile checked when the active profile cannot be read (no database).
